content_sections.heading: UERC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download UERC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate degree in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized institution of repute. Experience: 15 years of experience in large public utilities specializing in electricity generation, transmission and distribution or in electricity regulatory sector. Holding analogous posts on regular basis OR 02 years regular service in the Pay Level-13 A or equivalent OR 03 years regular service in the Pay Level-13 or equivalent. Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on last date of Submission of Application) Other conditions: The mode of appointment is deputation from Central/State/UT Government Departments, Statutory/Autonomous/Constitutional/Cooperative/Local Government bodies and Public Sector Undertakings, Corporations etc. Desirable: Post graduate degree or diploma/MBA in Finance from a recognized university/institute of repute. Experience in development of electricity tariff, commercial issues and power purchase agreements.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The deputation shall be for a period upto 03 years initially, which may be extended as per deputation rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UERC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the format of application from the Commission's website www.uerc.uk.gov.in. Attach self-attested copies of certificates/mark sheets for educational qualifications (starting from matriculation), category and experience. Send by Speed Post only to Secretary, Uttarakhand Electricity Regulatory Commission, 'Vidyut Niyamak Bhawan', Near ISBT, PO-Majra, Dehradun-248171 (Uttarakhand) latest by 7th December, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applicants in Central/State/UT Government service or Autonomous/Statutory Body/PSUs/Corporations should apply through proper channel with ACRs and vigilance clearance. Advance copy may be sent directly, but NOC must be produced prior to interview.
